title: TouchGrass
claim: Product Hunt: TouchGrass — Context-aware break reminders without invasive permissions
why_good: TouchGrass addresses a growing concern for mental health and productivity by promoting regular breaks, which is increasingly recognized as essential in remote work environments.
value: Companies could pay for premium features to integrate TouchGrass into their employee wellness programs, enhancing productivity and reducing burnout costs.
risk: The market for break reminder tools is crowded, and larger companies could easily integrate similar features into existing productivity software.
evidence: Health & Fitness, Productivity, Menu Bar Apps
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
